introduction: 区分画布状态条与主窗日志底栏；恢复直接声明和选定原件体，错误导航仍保留明确未知。

edges.behavior: 原提取DiagramArea声明SelectedItem绑定父DiagramArea.SelectedItem、StatusSymbol/StatusInfo读当前WorkState/WorkStateInfo、ZoomIndex对IZoomIndex.PartentZoomIndex TwoWay、CurDiagramAreaSource读DecorateSource。不是主窗日志条的LogCommand/LogTypeCommand入口。

edges.to: Nullable IsReady / UnReady ID与名称 / 状态枚举
edges.behavior: 两个getter均先HasValue，再另读IsReady.Value，不是一次原子快照。无值时WorkStateInfo写等待文字；false时写UnReadyModuleID/Name加参数未完成文字；true时只返回原_WorkStateInfo，不在此清字段。WorkState对应NOItem/WaitConfig/Ready。所选StatusBar原模板另声明Ready/NOItem文字Setter，不能由缓存字段直接推断最终显示残留错误。

refs.excerpt:
<DataTrigger Value="Ready" Binding="{Binding Path=StatusSymbol, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}">
          <Setter TargetName="PART_StatusBg" Property="Image.Source" Value="/Apps.Style;component/Resources/bottombar_run.png" />
          <Setter TargetName="PART_StatusInfo" Value="{DynamicResource 组件配置完成}" Property="TextBlock.Text" />
        </DataTrigger>
        <DataTrigger Value="NOItem" Binding="{Binding Path=StatusSymbol, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}">
          <Setter TargetName="PART_StatusBg" Property="Image.Source" Value="/Apps.Style;component/Resources/bottombar_config.png" />
          <Setter TargetName="PART_StatusInfo" Value="{DynamicResource 等待添加组件}" Property="TextBlock.Text" />
        </DataTrigger>
        <DataTrigger Value="WaitConfig" Binding="{Binding Path=StatusSymbol, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}">
          <Setter TargetName="PART_StatusBg" Property="Image.Source" Value="/Apps.Style;component/Resources/bottombar_abnormal.png" />
          <Setter TargetName="m_StatusBar" Value="{DynamicResource StatusBarFg}" Property="Control.Foreground" />
        </DataTrigger>
      </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
    </ControlTemplate>

edges.behavior: newValue为IDecorate时取DecorateSource，普通非null对象直接保留，null清源。SelectedItemSource回调按IVmProcedure判IsProcedure，再按IVmModule且非流程判IsModule。所选耗时模板读SelectedItemSource.Root、ProcessTime/ModuleTime/AlgorithmTime及RunEnable声明门，不把状态条选择等同一次运行。

refs.excerpt:
<DataTemplate x:Key="TimeTemplate">
        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" TextBlock.Foreground="{DynamicResource Col_ProcessTimeConsuming_Foreground}">
          <ContentPresenter Name="cp" ContentTemplate="{StaticResource ProcessTemplate}" Content="{Binding SelectedItemSource, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Mode=FindAncestor, AncestorType=local:StatusBar}}" />
          <TextBlock Margin="0,0,2,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
          <TextBlock Text="{DynamicResource Lang_Modu}" Margin="0,0,2,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
          <TextBlock Margin="5,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="{Binding Path=SelectedItemSource.ModuleTime, Mode=OneWay, StringFormat=N2, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Mode=FindAncestor, AncestorType=local:StatusBar}}" />
          <TextBlock Text="ms" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
          <Rectangle Width="1" Fill="{DynamicResource Col_ProcessTimeConsuming_Foreground}" Margin="20,0" />
          <TextBlock Text="{DynamicResource 算法}" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
          <TextBlock Margin="5,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="{Binding Path=SelectedItemSource.AlgorithmTime, Mode=OneWay, StringFormat=N2, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Mode=FindAncestor, AncestorType=local:StatusBar}}" />
          <TextBlock Text="ms" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
        </StackPanel>
        <DataTemplate.Triggers>
          <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedItemSource.Root, Mode=OneWay, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Mode=FindAncestor, AncestorType=local:StatusBar}}" Value="{x:Null}">
            <Setter TargetName="cp" Property="ContentPresenter.Content" Value="{x:Null}" />
            <Setter TargetName="cp" Property="ContentPresenter.ContentTemplate" Value="{x:Null}" />
          </DataTrigger>
        </DataTemplate.Triggers>
      </DataTemplate>
      <DataTemplate x:Key="ProcessTimeTemplate">
        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" TextBlock.Foreground="{DynamicResource Col_ProcessTimeConsuming_Foreground}">
          <ContentPresenter Name="cp" ContentTemplate="{StaticResource ProcessTemplate}" Content="{Binding SelectedItemSource, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Mode=FindAncestor, AncestorType=local:StatusBar}}" />
        </StackPanel>

edges.behavior: 原模板Slider.Value TwoWay绑定ZoomIndex，Maximum读ZoomTicksCount；getter为Count-1。ZoomValueE索引有效时取_ZoomTicks[index]*100，否则返回1.0；回调只通知ZoomValueE。按钮找列表1.0的索引并在有效时赋ZoomIndex，不在所选体直接调用画布缩放API。初始列表0.1到2.0，但公开可写列表不是全生命周期固定常量。
